name: IT Job Hunter — Scheduled Job Discovery

nodes.name: Every 6 Hours
nodes.notes: Discovery cadence. Change hoursInterval to adjust. Deliberately infrequent — entry-level job postings don't change minute to minute, and each run makes real requests to employer job boards.

nodes.name: Run Discovery
nodes.notes: Calls the local dashboard's discovery endpoint. host.docker.internal resolves the Mac host from inside the n8n container (see extra_hosts in docker-compose.yml). REQUIRES the dashboard to be running: python -m src.dashboard.app. 30-minute timeout because each qualified job runs real local AI (analysis + tailoring + cover letter + QC), which is slow by design.

nodes.name: Any New Jobs?
nodes.notes: Only continue when discovery actually inserted something new — avoids a pointless log entry on every quiet run.

assignments.name: summary
assignments.value: ={{ 'Discovery: ' + $json.inserted + ' new, ' + $json.duplicates + ' duplicates. Ready to apply: ' + ($json.pipeline ? $json.pipeline.ready_to_apply : 0) + ', rejected: ' + ($json.pipeline ? $json.pipeline.rejected : 0) }}

nodes.name: Summarize Run
nodes.notes: The per-job desktop/Telegram notifications are already sent by the existing pipeline (src/notifications/) as each application is generated — this node just produces a run-level summary visible in n8n's execution log.
